topic: dtfile directory position-save and timer status packets

coverage: complete position-save status writes and exact callback reads
complete timer result writes and transactional exact reads
truncated timer timestamps and Boolean fields
bounded saved-position and timer child-path construction
source contracts for malformed sticky-worker retirement and stable ENOENT/EACCES handling

native_build.warnings: Only the pre-existing assignment-condition warning in UpdateAllProcess.

postconditions: make -n reports dtfile is up to date
no owned compiler, make or test process remained before returning CPU2
malformed fixed-field replies reset scheduling state without reusing a desynchronized worker
missing position files are treated as an already-complete removal
rejected_or_corrected_attempts: The first Motif transfer archive used the default tar format and rounded nanosecond mtimes. It was rejected before publication; a PAX-format retry preserved and verified every byte, mode, symlink target and nanosecond mtime.

The first dry run exposed config.status's historical source-root path. It was corrected to the retained staged source before compilation; the repeated dry run then showed only Directory.o and the dtfile relink.
limitations: This non-visual worker-protocol bundle did not launch or inspect a CDE window.
The qualified ck-core-fs-lib revision exposes no accepted atomic-replacement writer API, so position-file replacement behavior is not claimed crash-safe in this round.
